findings.title: order() mixin is off by one for legacy box layouts
findings.body: The mixin copies the same value to -webkit-box-ordinal-group/-moz-box-ordinal-group and to modern order, but the legacy box ordinal-group properties are 1-based while order is 0-based. Thus order(0) produces an invalid ordinal-group below 1, and order(1) collides with unordered items (legacy default group 1) while placing the item second in modern browsers. The legacy values should be $val + 1. This makes the new reusable mixin produce different ordering in the legacy WebKit/Mozilla engines it explicitly targets.

findings.title: align-items() does not translate values for legacy flexbox properties
findings.body: The mixin passes $alignment verbatim to -webkit-box-align and -ms-flex-align, but those legacy properties use start/end rather than the modern flex-start/flex-end keywords, so a natural call such as align-items(flex-start) or align-items(flex-end) will be dropped by the legacy engines the prefixes exist for. It also emits -ms-align-items on line 121, which is not a recognized IE10 property (the recognized one, -ms-flex-align, is already present), and omits -moz-box-align despite flexbox() emitting display:-moz-box. Current callers use center/baseline, which coincide in both vocabularies, but the generic mixin contract is broken for other valid alignments.

findings.title: Small-action button loses its right-edge alignment in the new flex row
findings.body: .small-action is now a flex container (lines 264-265), so its direct children become flex items and the button's float:right on line 309 is ignored by flex layout. Neither the button nor .small-action-desc is given flex-grow, width:100%, or margin-left:auto, so the delete button will sit immediately after the description text at a position that varies with text length instead of at the far right of the row as the floated layout placed it. Add e.g. margin-left:auto to the button (or make the description flex-grow) to preserve the alignment, as was done for .panel in header.scss.
